name: codepunk
description: Local-first, supervised coding agent for teams.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codepunk/protocol build && pnpm --filter @codepunk/core build && pnpm --filter @codepunk/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @codepunk/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @codepunk/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @codepunk/cli typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build && node scripts/check-repo.mjs --require-built
